strings.about.description: Setup tool for Chinese macro keyboards on CH552 and CH57x chips: keys, knobs, media, mouse and system actions. No installation needed — everything is stored next to the program.

strings.service.offer.text: Then volume, tracks and other button actions will keep working even when the program is closed. The service starts with Windows and shows no windows. You can remove or reinstall it in “Settings → Background service”.
strings.settings.appearance.hint: The theme changes the colours of the window, the keyboard picture and all dialogs. Standard themes are in the themes folder (light and dark), your own ones in themes\custom.
strings.settings.autostart.hint: The program will start minimized to the tray. Not needed if the background service is installed.
strings.settings.confirmOverwrite.hint: If you drag an action onto a button that already has one, the program warns you. Can also be turned off with “Don't show again” in the warning itself.
strings.settings.device.hint: A driver describes a board: its USB ID, write format and layout. Usually it is chosen automatically; if your board differs from the picture, pick the right one manually.
strings.settings.keys.drag: Drag a key onto another to move its action; hold Ctrl to copy it.
strings.settings.language.hint: Language packs are in the language folder. The language changes immediately; Cancel brings back the previous one.
strings.settings.noRepeat: Don't repeat a combination while the key is held
strings.settings.noRepeat.hint: While a key is held, the board itself repeats the press about 9 times a second, so the combination stored in it fires again and again. With this option the program performs combinations — once per press, however long the key is held. The program or the background service must be running. Media and system actions are already performed once by the program; volume and brightness repeat while held.
strings.settings.service.autorun.hint: The same helper starts when you sign in to Windows, from “Task Manager → Startup”. If the Windows service is installed, autostart is not needed.
strings.settings.service.hint: {0} performs volume, tracks and other button actions when the program window is closed. It starts with Windows, shows no windows and hands the keys over while the program is open.
strings.settings.service.preset.hint: The service remembers the chosen preset and performs its actions. Usually it is the one written to the keyboard.
strings.settings.service.running: ● The service is installed and running

strings.settings.service.windows.failed: That did not work: administrator rights were not granted or Windows refused. You can use autostart without administrator rights instead.
strings.settings.service.windows.hint: Shown in the “Services” list as OMK Studio Service and starts before you sign in. Services have no access to the keyboard and sound themselves, so it starts a helper in your session and restarts it if it crashes. Installing and removing ask for administrator rights.

The keys did not send the test letters. Everything the keyboard sent has been logged — that is enough to look into it further.

{0}
strings.wizard.intro:
The wizard writes test letters to the keyboard and asks you to press each key and the knob in turn. From the letters it learns whether writing works and which numbers the knob has on your board.

First, unplug the USB cable and plug it back in — the wizard will notice it by itself. About a minute.
